description: Risk classes for agents, skills and changes, and what each class implies.

LOW.definition: Output is advisory or cosmetic; a wrong result is obvious and cheap to correct.

MEDIUM.definition: Output changes product behaviour but stays inside a reviewed merge request and is reversible.

implies.review: peer review plus at least one specialist reviewer by routing

HIGH.definition: Output shapes system-wide properties, security posture, data integrity or production behaviour.

implies.review: independent reviewer of the same discipline plus governance visibility
implies.human_approval: for the operations listed in policies/approval-policy.json

CRITICAL.definition: Output can compromise the organization's ability to detect or prevent harm, or performs an irreversible production action.

implies.review: two independent reviewers plus a named human owner
implies.evaluation_depth: full suite plus regression on every prior finding

raises_to_HIGH: touches authentication, authorization, session or crypto code
adds or changes a database migration
changes CI/CD, infrastructure or deployment configuration
adds a new external network dependency
raises_to_CRITICAL: touches production secrets or key material
performs or automates a production mutation
modifies this repository's hooks, policies or agent permissions
